crossStructureFindings: Existing source scripts and templates are common across scientific, legal, data and testing skills; reuse must be a first-class implementation path.
Small policy and template resources benefit from on-demand navigation, while current optimization context has no resource index.
Mechanical work and professional or live-state duties frequently coexist; packages must retain residual duties instead of claiming whole-task completion.
Entrypoints vary across Python modules, shell commands, declared tools and docs-only flows; helper detection cannot depend on api-task-solidify.js.

The acquisition closure scanner over-reports missing resources when it sees commands, examples, JSON pointers or placeholders; these diagnostics cannot be trusted as dependency facts without classification.
claimBoundary: Purposive development review, not a random corpus or generalization estimate. No protected, reserve, held-out or prospective source was read.
